title: Uniform norm with an extended exponent
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $q\in[0,\infty]$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define its uniform norm with exponent $q$ to be its uniform $L^\infty$ norm when $q=\infty$, and otherwise its uniform $L^q$ norm with exponent equal to the real value of $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is a nonnegative extended real number
